market_question: Will Houston Texans win the 2027 NFL AFC Championship?
reasoning: Three years is an eternity in the NFL; the Texans have a promising QB but remain far from AFC dominance. The AFC is loaded with elite franchises (Chiefs, Bengals, Bills, Ravens) that are better positioned. A 7% chance feels more realistic than 10.2% given the massive uncertainty and historical odds.
evidence_points: Current Super Bowl 2025 odds imply a ~5% chance for Texans to win AFC this year, and odds decay further into the future.
AFC powers like Kansas City, Cincinnati, and Buffalo project to remain strong, limiting Houston's path.
Historically, even teams with young stars rarely sustain championship-level contention for multiple consecutive deep runs.
sources_consulted: NFL futures odds on major sportsbooks
